API docs by Redocly

Wekan REST API (v11.06)

Download OpenAPI specification:

The REST API allows you to control and extend Wekan with ease.

If you are an end-user and not a dev or a tester, create an issue to request new APIs.

All API calls in the documentation are made using curl. However, you are free to use Java / Python / PHP / Golang / Ruby / Swift / Objective-C / Rust / Scala / C# or any other programming languages.

Production Security Concerns

When calling a production Wekan server, ensure it is running via HTTPS and has a valid SSL Certificate. The login method requires you to post your username and password in plaintext, which is why we highly suggest only calling the REST login api over HTTPS. Also, few things to note:

  • Only call via HTTPS
  • Implement a timed authorization token expiration strategy
  • Ensure the calling user only has permissions for what they are calling and no more

AttachmentStorageSettings

Get the attachment storage / upload-block settings (GlobalAdmin)

Only the global admin can call this. Returns the Admin Panel > Attachments settings document, including limitSettings.attachmentsUploadBlocked and limitSettings.avatarsUploadBlocked plus the size limits. Cloud-storage secret keys (S3 secretAccessKey, Azure accountKey/connectionString, GCS credentials) are masked and never returned; a boolean <field>Set marker shows whether a value exists.

Update the global Admin Panel settings

Only the global admin can call this. The request body is an object whose keys are settings fields to update (see get_global_settings for the list). Unknown keys and mailServer are ignored.

String(value || '') is trimmed and lowercased before matching. Strings and singleton arrays (including nested singleton arrays) can name a role. Accepted names: admin, normal, member, comment, commentonly, readonly, worker, normalassignedonly, commentassignedonly, readassignedonly, nocomments. Empty/multiple-role arrays are invalid. Perform an administrative action on a user.

Site-administrator access is required. takeOwnership transfers every board administered by the target user to the caller and returns affected board summaries. disableLogin sets loginDisabled and clears the target's existing sessions, but the v11.06 REST login handler does not inspect that field and can mint a new token with correct credentials. enableLogin omits loginDisabled from the returned user document; both login actions return sanitized user documents.

Authorizations:
UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurity

user
required
string
query Parameters
access_token
string

Global Bearer-token fallback. An Authorization Bearer header takes precedence.

required
action
required
string

Boards

This route is used to export a attachement to a json file format.

Public boards require no authentication. For a private board, pass a permitted user's login token as the authToken query parameter. In Wekan v11.06, an Authorization bearer token works only for a global administrator.

Authorizations:
UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurityNone

board
required
string
attachment
required
string
query Parameters
access_token
string

Global Bearer-token fallback. An Authorization Bearer header takes precedence.

authToken
string

/api/boards/{board}/attachments/{attachment}/export

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 403
  • 404
  • 413
Content type
{ }

This route is used to export the board to a json file format.

Public boards need no authentication. Private boards accept authToken or a bearer token from a user who can view the board.

Authorizations:
UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurityNone
path Parameters
board
required
string
query Parameters
access_token
string

Global Bearer-token fallback. An Authorization Bearer header takes precedence.

authToken
string
attachments
boolean

Set false to omit base64 file data.

fields
string

Comma-separated recognized sections: board-header, activities, labels, people, board-info, dates, description, custom-fields, checklists, subtasks, comments, attachments, voting, poker, stickers, locations, dependencies, sort. Unknown/empty keys are dropped; no recognized key means all sections.

swimlaneId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

listId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

cardId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

checklistId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

Responses

/api/boards/{board}/export

string

Import a .zip export - the document and its attachment files.

POST raw ZIP bytes containing wekan.json and optional attachments/- files. Imports into boardId, or into the named card/list/swimlane target. Pinned v11.06 defects: checklistId is parsed but never used by ScopedImporter, so it does not scope imports. Importing a mapped attachment with archive bytes hangs after importing earlier objects: addAttachmentFromStream passes a callback where ostrio:files3.0.1 addFile expects a Boolean third argument; the unawaited rejection leaves the surrounding promise unresolved and no HTTP response is produced. Client cancellation does not undo already imported objects, and both temporary files remain. Invalid scope strings are ignored. Field selection gates imported sections.

Authorizations:
UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurity
query Parameters
access_token
string

Global Bearer-token fallback. An Authorization Bearer header takes precedence.

boardId
required
string

ID of the existing board to import into.

authToken
string

Login token alternative to the Authorization bearer header.

fields
string

Comma-separated recognized sections: board-header, activities, labels, people, board-info, dates, description, custom-fields, checklists, subtasks, comments, attachments, voting, poker, stickers, locations, dependencies, sort. Unknown/empty keys are dropped; no recognized key means all sections.

swimlaneId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

listId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

cardId
string

Scope ID is honored only when matching ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; invalid values are ignored. Card scope takes precedence over checklist/list/swimlane scope.

checklistId
string

Ignored by ScopedImporter in v11.06, even if syntactically valid.

Wekan ZIP export streamed as the complete request body.

string <binary>

put_board_list_card

Fields are written sequentially without rollback. A later validation error can leave earlier changes persisted despite an error response. Partial updates. Many scalar fields are guarded by truthiness: empty title/description/color/parentId/requestedBy/assignedBy, sort 0 and spentTime 0 are ignored. Recognized updates acknowledge the requested ID even when no card matches. Same-board moves use listId/swimlaneId; cross-board moves run only when all newBoardId/newSwimlaneId/newListId are truthy, and override the same-board fields. Date null/empty/literal null clears. Vote/poker arrays reset, members/assignees normalize and filter to active board members. Locations generate IDs and numeric coordinates.

Permanently delete a card and its child resources.

Hard-deletes the card and cascades child resources. The endpoint always returns the requested card ID, including when the card does not exist, so success does not prove prior existence or removal. Supplying the correct board and card IDs with a wrong list ID can delete child resources while leaving the card itself intact.

Export a single card to Excel (.xlsx), formatted for DIN A4 Portrait printing.

If user is already logged-in, pass loginToken as param

"authToken": '/api/boards/:boardId/lists/:listId/cards/:cardId/exportExcel?authToken=:token'

Optional query param "fields" is a comma-separated list of sections to include. Valid values: people, board-info, dates, description, checklists, subtasks, comments Omitting "fields" includes all sections. In v11.06 a recognized fields selection omitting board-info fails with HTTP500 because the renderer passes null related documents to cardExportDocument.

Authorizations:
UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurityNone
path Parameters
board
required
string
list
required
string
card
required
string
query Parameters
access_token
string

Global Bearer-token fallback. An Authorization Bearer header takes precedence.

authToken
string
fields
string

Comma-separated recognized sections: labels, people, board-info, dates, description, custom-fields, checklists, subtasks, comments, attachments, voting, poker, stickers, locations, dependencies, sort. Unknown/empty keys are dropped; no recognized key means all sections.

lang
string

Language code; a saved user profile language takes precedence. Unsupported languages fall back to English where the route loads the bundle; anonymous/public card exports use this query language.

dateFormat
string

Recognizes YYYY-MM-DD, DD-MM-YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY. Other values fall back to saved user format or YYYY-MM-DD. Public card Excel ignores dateFormat in v11.06.

tz
string

Timezone string of at most64 characters is forwarded; longer/non-string values are ignored. Empty/no zone renders UTC. Public card Excel ignores tz in v11.06.

Responses

/api/boards/{board}/lists/{list}/cards/{card}/exportExcel

Import an iCalendar (.ics) file into a board as cards

Parses the supplied iCalendar text and creates one card per VEVENT on the given board / list / swimlane, populating each card's startAt (DTSTART) and dueAt (DTEND, or DTSTART when there is no DTEND) so the imported events appear on the Calendar and Gantt views.

Permissions: requires a valid auth token and write access to the board (read-only / comment-only / worker members are rejected; site admins are allowed).

post_board_list_move

Same-board move repositions the existing list and may change its swimlaneId. Cross-board move inserts/reuses the destination list, leaves the source list intact, ignores position, and returns the source list ID when it completes. A supplied destination swimlane is also used as a source-card filter and may leave cards unmoved. When a selected card is transferred, Cards.move writes it and then Meteor.userId() outside a DDP invocation throws: the route returns HTML 500 after partial mutation. Labels on a transferred card remap to existing destination labels by name; missing destination labels are dropped.

Add an automation rule to a board

The trigger and action are embedded inline. See the Rules documentation for the available trigger activityTypes and action actionTypes. Trigger matching fields that are omitted (e.g. userId, listName, swimlaneName, cardTitle) default to the '*' wildcard, so e.g. issue #2674's "remove a member when a card is moved away from a list" only needs trigger {activityType: 'moveCard', oldListName: '...'} and action {actionType: 'removeMember', username: '...'}.

Attachments

Upload a file as a card attachment

Upload a file to a card. The file content is sent base64-encoded in the JSON body. The maximum size is bounded by the admin Attachment Storage Settings (apiUploadMaxBytes) and a hard server safety cap (64 MB).

Permissions: requires a valid auth token, write access to the target board (read-only / comment-only / worker members are rejected), and the board must allow attachments.

UserSecurityAccessTokenSecurity
